Class JavaToJs

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.simulation.JavaToJs
public class JavaToJs extends Object
Translates a simulation model (a subclass of GridModel, ValueGridModel or AgentModel) from Java to JavaScript for the HTML export. The translation supports a subset of Java: fields, methods (no overloading), constructors, static nested classes, the statements (no try/catch), arrays, Math, lambdas, ArrayList and HashMap (the common methods), String methods and the integer division. Other constructs are reported as errors with the line number.

      Parameters:
